statement: Content-addressed immutable prior versions and logical/physical path separation are proven preservation patterns.
actakit_implication: Use immutable artifact identity/digests; do not make path the identity.

statement: Absolute immutability can collide with legitimate purge/redaction obligations.
actakit_implication: Define custody deletion/purge semantics explicitly instead of promising eternal bytes.

statement: Immutable-version preservation systems still need an exceptional purge path and may require object reconstruction to remove content.
actakit_implication: Model purge as explicit exceptional lifecycle action distinct from ordinary revision/redaction.
